targets.review_note: Unit-square placement and direction0/1/2/3=left/down/right/up are fully textual. Collect four corners of every placed square, construct exact integer convex hull, and inspect enclosing rectangles with a side along every hull edge. Rotating calipers tracks extrema of parallel and perpendicular projections; compare area numerator/edge-length-squared using integer cross multiplication, print with Decimal. The figure is illustrative. Several secondary samples are corrupted by machine translation (Five/Ten); do not invent them. Validate uncorrupted singleton sample, textual plus-shaped placement and independently enumerated hull-edge rectangles on random valid connected placements. Bound line incorrectly says n_i>=1 while narrative explicitly allows0; use narrative and examples consistently.
